title: Session
description: A conversation owned by a Persona. A Persona owns many, any number concurrently active. Normative.

version.description: Opaque optimistic-concurrency token; server-assigned, increments on each update. Clients send the current value as If-Match on mutation; a mismatch returns 409 version_conflict.

members.description: All participating persona ids, including the owner. Length > 1 = group session; empty or single = solo. Messages MUST carry actor attribution when > 1.

model.description: Effective model; null ⇒ inherit per Personas §5 precedence.

workspace.description: Opaque, host-defined execution locator (a directory on desktop, a repo/sandbox elsewhere). The spec never interprets it — echoed verbatim like a ModelId. null ⇒ no rooted workspace. Inherited by every loop stage and child agent spawned from this session (Foundation §4.4).
